description: Returns one of Xodia's skills (step-by-step instructions for a kind of work) for the project you are working on: core skills, plus the stack packs get_project lists for that project. Requests, prompts and the router name the skills and packs to follow; load each one when you start the work it covers, once per conversation, not ahead of time. Some skills end with a References list of longer detail: pass ref with one of those names only when the task needs it. tailwind-upgrade load without a projectId, for work before the site is in Xodia (tailwind-upgrade: a repo refused with tailwind3_unsupported). Skills are licensed to the workspace for use in Xodia: use them for the task, never copy, save or export them.

projectId.description: The project you are working on (from list_projects or the request). Required except for tailwind-upgrade

ref.description: A reference from the skill's References list, such as typography for design-system. Leave out to load the skill itself.

name: get_skill
title: Get skill
